|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 3, in date order). It is not the current version. The current version is [[Ancient Watering Hole (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2).
* '''Original''' ([[Ancient Watering Hole]], 7 January 2019): Original: the image at the set's official release (8 January 2019). Players Committee card image, 7 January 2019: 0 side [[:File:V10-L-ancientwateringhole-20190107.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e0ebcbc/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Light/large/ancientwateringhole.gif Holotable commit e0ebcbc “Set 10 images”], no mark). Text: “Deploy on table. Maz and your Rep are immune to attrition. While you have alien characters of five different species on table: your Force drains are +1, your total battle destiny is +1 (+2 if Maz or your Rep in battle), and your aliens are forfeit +1. [Immune to Alter.]”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page, 19 August 2024): Players Committee card image, 19 August 2024: 0 side [[:File:V10-L-ancientwateringhole-20240819.png]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/a20089e/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Light/hires/ancientwateringhole.png Holotable commit a20089e “Virtual Set 10 Remastered”], no mark). Text: “Deploy on table. Maz and your Rep are immune to attrition. While you have alien characters of five different species on table: your Force drains are +1, your total battle destiny is +1 (+2 if Maz or your Rep in battle), and your aliens are forfeit +1. [Immune to Alter.]” '''What changed:''' Virtual Set 10 remaster: new art (credit “Image courtesy of Robert Rose”), new copyright line (“ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.”), re-rendered at 745×1039 (was 350×490); the words are unchanged; no mark. Listed as its own version under Bill's rulings of 12 November 2026 (every visible change on a PC image is a version).
*: [[File:V10-L-ancientwateringhole-20240819-changes.png|frameless|upright=2.6|alt=Before and after]] ''Before (left) and after (right): cropped from the published images.''
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Ancient Watering Hole (Errata 2)]], 29 December 2024): Players Committee card image, 29 December 2024: 0 side [[:File:V10-L-ancientwateringhole.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/efc26cd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Light/hires/ancientwateringhole.png Holotable commit efc26cd “Set 24 Part 2 (Errata and fixes)”], mark “E1”). Text: “Deploy on table. Your Rep is immune to attrition. While you have alien characters of five different species on table, at locations where you have an alien: Your total battle destiny is +1, your aliens are forfeit +1 and, if location is a battleground, your Force drains are +1. [Immune to Alter.]” '''What changed:''' “Maz and your Rep are immune to attrition” became “Your Rep is immune to attrition”; the five-species clause now applies “at locations where you have an alien” and reads “Your total battle destiny is +1, your aliens are forfeit +1 and, if location is a battleground, your Force drains are +1.” (the Maz/Rep +2 is gone). '''PC transcription error:''' the card prints the errata mark “E1”, but this is errata version 2 by release order (PC-E2); see [[Players Committee transcription errors]].
|hatnote=Other versions of this card: [[Ancient Watering Hole]] (original), [[Ancient Watering Hole (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2).
